definitions.explanation: Something being completely ruined or made worthless. Used when effort, plans, or something of value is destroyed or wasted.

examples.japanese: せっかくの{計画|けいかく}が{台無|だいな}しになった。
examples.english: The carefully made plan was ruined.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}で{旅行|りょこう}が{台無|だいな}しだ。
あの{一言|ひとこと}で{楽|たの}しかった{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{全部|ぜんぶ}{台無|だいな}しになってしまった。
examples.english: That one remark completely ruined the fun atmosphere.

notes:
Very often used with せっかく (with effort, specially) to express frustration that something done with care or effort has been wasted. Common patterns: 〜が{台無|だいな}しになる (something gets ruined) and 〜を{台無|だいな}しにする (to ruin something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台無|だいな}しになる: to be ruined
- {台無|だいな}しにする: to ruin
- せっかくの〜が{台無|だいな}し: the specially prepared ~ is ruined
- {全部|ぜんぶ}{台無|だいな}し: all ruined
